import MumfordLib.BarycentricSubdivisionHomotopy
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionChainMap
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionSupport

/-!
# The singular subdivision homotopy

Evaluate the affine subdivision homotopy along each singular simplex. Its
affine naturality identifies the face terms in the homotopy equation, giving
a natural chain homotopy from the identity to singular subdivision.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X Y : TopCat} {n : ℕ}

/-- The degree-raising singular subdivision homotopy operator. -/
def singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X n ⟶
      (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X (n + 1) :=
  Sigma.desc fun σ => vertexListChain stdSimplex.vertex ≫
    barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap n n ≫
      (affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ)).f (n + 1)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    singularSimplexChain σ ≫ singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n =
      vertexListChain stdSimplex.vertex ≫ barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap n n ≫
        (affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ)).f (n + 1) :=
  Sigma.ι_desc _ _

@[simp]
theorem singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_zero (X : TopCat) :
    singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X 0 = 0 := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro σ
  change singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _ = singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _
  simp only [singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy,
    barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_zero, zero_comp, comp_zero]

/-- The homotopy on a face agrees with its affine evaluation in the original simplex. -/
theorem singularSimplexChain_face_subdivisionHomotopy
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n + 1⦌)) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    singularSimplexChain ((TopCat.toSSet.obj X).δ i σ) ≫
        singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n =
      vertexListChain (stdSimplex.vertex ∘ i.succAbove) ≫
        barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap (n + 1) n ≫
          (affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n + 1⦌) σ)).f (n + 1) := by
  rw [singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy, affineSingularEvaluation_face]
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f]
  rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap n n),
    barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc, vertexListChain_vertices_map_assoc]

/-- The positive-degree singular homotopy equation. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_boundary (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X (n + 1) ≫
        (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 2) (n + 1) =
      𝟙 _ - singularSubdivision X (n + 1) -
        (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n ≫
          singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro σ
  change singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _ = singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _
  rw [singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy_assoc]
  rw [(affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n + 1⦌) σ)).comm]
  rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap (n + 1) (n + 1)),
    barycentricSubdivisionHomotopyMap_boundary]
  simp only [Preadditive.sub_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.id_comp,
    Category.comp_id, Category.assoc]
  rw [vertexListChain_vertices_affineSingularEvaluation, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    ← singularSimplexChain_subdivision]
  rw [vertexListChain_boundary_assoc, singularSimplexChain_boundary_assoc]
  simp only [Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.zsmul_comp,
    singularSimplexChain_face_subdivisionHomotopy]

/-- The subdivision homotopy operator is natural in the topological space. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n ≫
        (SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).f (n + 1) =
      (SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).f n ≫
        singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap Y n := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro σ
  change singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _ = singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _
  rw [singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy_assoc]
  erw [singularSimplexChain_map_assoc f σ, singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy]
  erw [← HomologicalComplex.comp_f (affineSingularEvaluation _) _,
    affineSingularEvaluation_postcomp]
  rfl

/-- Singular barycentric subdivision is chain homotopic to the identity. -/
def singularSubdivisionHomotopy (X : TopCat) :
    Homotopy (𝟙 (IntegralSingularChainComplex X)) (singularSubdivisionChainMap X) where
  hom i j := if h : i + 1 = j then
    singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X i ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X h) else 0
  zero i j hij := by
    change ¬ i + 1 = j at hij
    simp only [dif_neg hij]
  comm i := by
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        rw [Homotopy.dNext_zero_chainComplex, Homotopy.prevD_chainComplex]
        simp
    | succ n =>
        rw [Homotopy.dNext_succ_chainComplex, Homotopy.prevD_chainComplex]
        simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id,
          HomologicalComplex.id_f, singularSubdivisionChainMap_f]
        change 𝟙 _ =
          (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n ≫
              singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n +
            singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X (n + 1) ≫
              (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 2) (n + 1) +
            singularSubdivision X (n + 1)
        rw [singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_boundary]
        abel

@[simp]
theorem singularSubdivisionHomotopy_hom (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularSubdivisionHomotopy X).hom n (n + 1) =
      singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n := by
  simp [singularSubdivisionHomotopy]

/-- The homotopy of a small simplex stays in the small chain complex. -/
theorem singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy_small_factor {ι : Type*}
    (U : ι → Set X) (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌))
    (hσ : σ ∈ (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    ∃ c : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X (n + 1),
      c ≫ (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f (n + 1) =
        singularSimplexChain σ ≫ singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n :=
  singularSimplexChain_naturalOperator_small_factor
    (fun Y => singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap Y n)
    (fun f => singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_naturality f n) U σ hσ

/-- Subdivision changes a positive-degree cocycle by an explicit coboundary. -/
theorem singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_coboundary
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1)) (hφ : singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0) :
    singularCochainCoboundary (singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n ≫ φ) =
      φ - singularSubdivision X (n + 1) ≫ φ := by
  have h := congrArg (fun k => k ≫ φ) (singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_boundary X n)
  change (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 2) (n + 1) ≫ φ = 0 at hφ
  simp only [Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, hφ,
    comp_zero] at h
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp h.symm).symm

end Mumford.Analytic
